<script>
/* Prime Exteriors - front end behaviour patch
   Paste into the site's custom scripts / GA script field (footer position).
   Self contained, no dependencies, safe to load more than once. */
(function () {
  if (window.__pxBehaviour) return;
  window.__pxBehaviour = true;

  var DESKTOP = '(min-width: 1301px)';
  function isDesktop() { return window.matchMedia(DESKTOP).matches; }
  function closest(el, sel) { return el && el.closest ? el.closest(sel) : null; }
  function each(list, fn) { Array.prototype.forEach.call(list || [], fn); }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     1. HEADER DROPDOWNS  (Services mega panel + Commercial panel)
     CSS already has .pe-nav__btn[aria-expanded="true"] + .pe-mega { display:block }
     so all that is missing is the aria-expanded toggle.
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function panelFor(btn) {
    var n = btn && btn.nextElementSibling;
    return (n && (n.classList.contains('pe-mega') || n.classList.contains('pe-drop'))) ? n : null;
  }

  function closeMenus(except) {
    each(document.querySelectorAll('.pe-nav__btn[aria-expanded="true"]'), function (b) {
      if (b !== except) b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = closest(e.target, '.pe-nav__btn');
    if (btn && panelFor(btn)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      closeMenus(btn);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'false' : 'true');
      return;
    }
    // click anywhere outside the nav closes any open panel
    if (!closest(e.target, '.pe-nav')) closeMenus(null);
  });

  // follow a link inside a panel, then tidy up
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (closest(e.target, '.pe-mega a, .pe-drop a')) closeMenus(null);
  });

  // Click to open only. Hovering a panel never opens or closes it.
  // Tabbing out of an open panel closes it, so keyboard users are not left with a stray panel.
  document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
    if (!isDesktop()) return;
    var open = document.querySelector('.pe-nav__btn[aria-expanded="true"]');
    if (!open) return;
    var item = closest(open, '.pe-nav__item');
    if (item && !item.contains(e.target)) closeMenus(null);
  });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     2. HAMBURGER / MOBILE NAV
     CSS already has .pe-nav.is-open { display:block ... } under 1300px.
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function nav() { return document.getElementById('pe-nav'); }
  function burger() { return document.querySelector('.pe-burger'); }

  function setNav(open) {
    var n = nav(), b = burger();
    if (!n) return;
    n.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
    if (b) {
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
    }
    if (!open) closeMenus(null);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = closest(e.target, '.pe-burger');
    if (b) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setNav(!(nav() && nav().classList.contains('is-open')));
      return;
    }
    var n = nav();
    if (!n || !n.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    if (closest(e.target, '.pe-nav a')) { setNav(false); return; }          // navigating away
    if (!closest(e.target, '.pe-nav') && !closest(e.target, '.pe-head')) setNav(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (isDesktop()) setNav(false); });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     3. GET A QUOTE SIDEBAR
     Markup ships with hidden="" on the panel and scrim; CSS animates .is-open.
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  var lastFocus = null;

  function panel() { return document.getElementById('pe-quote-panel'); }
  function scrim() { return document.querySelector('.pe-qscrim'); }

  function openQuote(trigger) {
    var p = panel(), s = scrim();
    if (!p) return;
    lastFocus = trigger || document.activeElement;
    setNav(false);
    if (s) s.hidden = false;
    p.hidden = false;
    void p.offsetWidth;                                  // force a reflow so the slide animates
    if (s) s.classList.add('is-open');
    p.classList.add('is-open');
    document.body.classList.add('pe-locked');
    each(document.querySelectorAll('[data-quote-open][aria-expanded]'), function (b) {
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    });
    var field = p.querySelector('.pe-qstep:not([hidden]) input, .pe-qstep:not([hidden]) select, .pe-qstep:not([hidden]) textarea');
    if (field) setTimeout(function () { try { field.focus(); } catch (err) {} }, 340);
  }

  function closeQuote() {
    var p = panel(), s = scrim();
    if (!p || p.hidden) return;
    p.classList.remove('is-open');
    if (s) s.classList.remove('is-open');
    document.body.classList.remove('pe-locked');
    each(document.querySelectorAll('[data-quote-open][aria-expanded]'), function (b) {
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (!p.classList.contains('is-open')) { p.hidden = true; if (s) s.hidden = true; }
    }, 340);
    if (lastFocus) { try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (err) {} lastFocus = null; }
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var open = closest(e.target, '[data-quote-open]');
    if (open) { e.preventDefault(); openQuote(open); return; }
    if (closest(e.target, '[data-quote-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeQuote(); return; }
    // any plain anchor pointing at the panel
    var a = closest(e.target, 'a[href="#pe-quote-panel"]');
    if (a) { e.preventDefault(); openQuote(a); }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape' && e.keyCode !== 27) return;
    var p = panel();
    if (p && !p.hidden) { closeQuote(); return; }
    if (nav() && nav().classList.contains('is-open')) { setNav(false); return; }
    closeMenus(null);
  });

  // keep tab focus inside the drawer while it is open
  document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
    var p = panel();
    if (!p || p.hidden || p.contains(e.target)) return;
    var f = p.querySelector('button, [href], input, select, textarea');
    if (f) f.focus();
  });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     4. MULTI STEP QUOTE FORM  (runs on every .pe-qform on the page)
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function steps(form) { return form.querySelectorAll('.pe-qstep[data-step]'); }

  function currentStep(form) {
    var n = 1;
    each(steps(form), function (fs) { if (!fs.hidden) n = parseInt(fs.getAttribute('data-step'), 10) || n; });
    return n;
  }

  function paint(form, n) {
    var total = steps(form).length;
    each(steps(form), function (fs) {
      var i = parseInt(fs.getAttribute('data-step'), 10);
      fs.hidden = (i !== n);
      fs.classList.toggle('is-on', i === n);
    });

    var ticks = form.previousElementSibling;
    if (!ticks || !ticks.classList.contains('pe-qsteps')) {
      ticks = (form.parentNode || document).querySelector('.pe-qsteps');
    }
    if (ticks) {
      each(ticks.children, function (li, idx) {
        li.classList.toggle('is-on', idx + 1 === n);
        li.classList.toggle('is-done', idx + 1 < n);
      });
    }

    var back = form.querySelector('.pe-qback');
    var next = form.querySelector('.pe-qnext');
    var send = form.querySelector('.pe-qsend');
    if (back) back.hidden = (n === 1);
    if (next) next.hidden = (n >= total);
    if (send) send.hidden = (n < total);
  }

  function validStep(form, n) {
    var fs = form.querySelector('.pe-qstep[data-step="' + n + '"]');
    if (!fs) return true;
    var bad = null;
    var seenRadio = {};
    each(fs.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea'), function (el) {
      if (el.disabled || el.type === 'hidden') return;
      if (el.type === 'radio') {
        if (seenRadio[el.name]) return;
        seenRadio[el.name] = true;
      }
      var ok = el.checkValidity();
      var chips = closest(el, '.pe-qchips');
      if (chips) chips.classList.toggle('is-bad', !ok);
      else el.classList.toggle('is-bad', !ok);
      if (!ok && !bad) bad = el;
    });
    if (bad) {
      try { bad.reportValidity(); } catch (err) { bad.focus(); }
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function goTo(form, n) {
    var total = steps(form).length;
    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(total, n));
    paint(form, n);
    var box = closest(form, '.pe-qpanel') || form;
    var top = box.getBoundingClientRect().top;
    if (top < 0 || top > window.innerHeight) box.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    else if (box.scrollTop) box.scrollTop = 0;
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = closest(e.target, '.pe-qnext, .pe-qback');
    if (!btn) return;
    var form = closest(btn, 'form');
    if (!form || !steps(form).length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var n = currentStep(form);
    if (btn.classList.contains('pe-qback')) { goTo(form, n - 1); return; }
    if (validStep(form, n)) goTo(form, n + 1);
  });

  // clear the red state as soon as the visitor corrects the field
  document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    var el = e.target;
    if (!el || !closest(el, '.pe-qform')) return;
    el.classList.remove('is-bad');
    var chips = closest(el, '.pe-qchips');
    if (chips) chips.classList.remove('is-bad');
  });
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
    var chips = closest(e.target, '.pe-qchips');
    if (chips) chips.classList.remove('is-bad');
  });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     5. BEFORE AND AFTER SLIDERS
     CSS drives the clip path from --pos on .px-ba; the range input is the control.
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function setPos(range) {
    var card = closest(range, '.px-ba');
    if (card) card.style.setProperty('--pos', range.value + '%');
  }

  document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains('px-ba__range')) setPos(e.target);
  });

  function drag(on) {
    return function (e) {
      var r = closest(e.target, '.px-ba') ? closest(e.target, '.px-ba').querySelector('.px-ba__range') : null;
      if (!r) return;
      closest(r, '.px-ba').classList.toggle('is-drag', on);
    };
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', drag(true));
  document.addEventListener('pointerup', drag(false));
  document.addEventListener('pointercancel', drag(false));

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     6. BACK TO TOP BUTTON
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (closest(e.target, '.pe-top')) window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  function scrolled() {
    var b = document.querySelector('.pe-top');
    if (b) b.classList.toggle('is-on', window.pageYOffset > 700);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', scrolled, { passive: true });

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     INITIAL PASS
  ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function init() {
    each(document.querySelectorAll('.px-ba__range'), setPos);
    each(document.querySelectorAll('.pe-qform'), function (form) {
      if (!steps(form).length) return;
      // Put the submit button first in the DOM, keep the visual order with flex order,
      // so the lead script's "first button" lookup finds Send rather than Back.
      var nav = form.querySelector('.pe-qnav');
      var back = form.querySelector('.pe-qback');
      var next = form.querySelector('.pe-qnext');
      var send = form.querySelector('.pe-qsend');
      if (nav && send && back && next && nav.firstElementChild !== send) {
        nav.insertBefore(send, nav.firstElementChild);
        back.style.order = '1'; next.style.order = '2'; send.style.order = '3';
      }
      paint(form, 1);
    });
    scrolled();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
